## Goal
Expand from turn/SP planner to richer timeline simulation.

## Tasks
- [ ] Add ultimate energy tracking.
- [ ] Add speed buffs and action advance effects.
- [ ] Add enemy-turn simulation for boss pacing.
- [ ] Add support for multiple saved rotations.
- [ ] Add share by link.
- [ ] Add export/import by JSON.
- [ ] Add image export.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Sim output is deterministic.
- [ ] Saved rotations persist and can be switched safely.
- [ ] Shared payload can be loaded and replayed.
